definitions.explanation: A building providing shared living quarters, typically for students, workers, or employees. Often associated with schools or workplaces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄宿舎|きしゅくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in the school dormitory.

examples.japanese: {寄宿舎|きしゅくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{門限|もんげん}→門限：14889_mongen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寄宿舎|きしゅくしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}している→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Students who came from the countryside are living in the dormitory.

notes:
A compound of {寄宿|きしゅく} (boarding, lodging) + {舎|しゃ} (building, quarters). A somewhat formal or traditional term for dormitory accommodations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄宿舎|きしゅくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to move into a dormitory
- {寄宿舎|きしゅくしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live in a dormitory
- {寄宿舎|きしゅくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧: dormitory rules
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{寄宿舎|きしゅくしゃ}: student dormitory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧: dormitory — the more common everyday word for dormitories, especially student or company housing
- {宿舎|しゅくしゃ}: quarters, lodging — broader term for any kind of accommodation provided by an organization
- ⟦{下宿|げしゅく}→下宿：01399_geshuku⟧: boarding house — a privately run lodging where one rents a room, often with meals provided
